nodes.name: Deployment
nodes.notes: Ship small changes through staging. Keep a tested rollback available.

nodes.name: Monitoring
nodes.notes: Watch request latency, error rates, and queue depth. Record actionable alerts.

nodes.name: Recovery
nodes.notes: Document backup ownership and rehearse restoring the database.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL
nodes.notes: Store accounts, permissions, orders, and other transactional records.

nodes.name: Redis cache
nodes.notes: Cache frequently read data. Decide expiry and invalidation rules.

nodes.name: Object storage
nodes.notes: Store uploaded files separately from application records.

nodes.name: Billing
nodes.notes: Keep pricing and payment rules explicit and covered by tests.

nodes.name: Notifications
nodes.notes: Deliver email and in-app updates. Track retries and user preferences.

nodes.name: Background jobs
nodes.notes: Run durable asynchronous work with bounded retries.

nodes.name: Authentication
nodes.notes:
Sign-in and access control

Validate credentials and create a session.
Check permissions on every protected request.

Next step
Test expired sessions and role changes.

nodes.name: REST API
nodes.notes: Define predictable endpoints, response formats, and error handling.

nodes.name: Validation
nodes.notes: Validate inputs at the boundary before invoking business rules.

nodes.name: Dashboard
nodes.notes: Give users an overview of the information and actions they need most.

nodes.name: Design system
nodes.notes: Collect reusable components, colors, spacing, and interaction patterns.

nodes.name: Accessibility
nodes.notes: Check keyboard navigation, focus states, contrast, and screen-reader labels.
